reviews_content: A genuine look back in time. At first it looks like a dodgy theater, based in the basement floor of a everything but abandoned shopping center. Upon further inspection, you notice its charm. A theater built probably in the 70s/80s, it's small, has only three halls and the seats are a few decades outdated.  The movie we went to was a 22:30 showing, there were about 10 people total in the theater, it somehow made the movie much better. You feel free to whisper, laugh out loud and talk about the movie, and although everyone can hear you, it disturbs no one. The comfort you feel just make it a more genuine movie viewing experience, as opposed to the very institutionalised movie experience of today.  Also, the was an INTERLUDE! Who does that anymore?? || I've been to a lot of run-down movie theatres, and this is easily the worst.  FIRST, they don't have a website, so I found movie listings on seret.co.il, but when we made a trip to this theatre - the only one in town - the listings turned out to have been all wrong, like the movie didn't even exist. Cashier shrugged and was like, "It's not our site." Like - surely there's a way to fix that; this is 2022 and people plan moviegoing online.  SECOND, it's in a charmless bunker in the basement and the seats, floor, etc., are grungy from years of wear and tear. A group of older teens came in late and shouted through the entire movie. One guy even took a call - he was like, "I'm at the theatre," and proceeded to talk about the movie. I guess it's a plus that a staff person asked us if we wanted the air conditioning on; otherwise, we might have suffocated. Yuck. Surely with all the tourists in town, a decent theatre could attract some business?  Giving it 2 stars because we were actually able to see a movie, even if we couldn't hear a lot of it because of the shouting hoodlums in the back row. Oh, and the bathrooms were actually really good. Lots of soap, paper, and very clean. If only the theatres were as good as the toilets. || This theater is really fun to see a blockbuster - the big theater is grand enough to make it feel like a special occasion! The staff is very nice and the ladies rooms are clean and classy looking. If you are new to Israeli movie theaters, heads up - if there is a brief pause in the middle of the film, it's not broken.. it is intermission! Take a moment to laugh at the awkward spot they stopped the film, and then take a tinkle (or whatever). Have fun, enjoy the movie! || Very old place, but it has its own rarity. || If I could give a negative score for this place as a movie theater, I would. Lets just say the highlight of the evening was when one of the staff threatened to call the police on people who were being rude. The sound system is decent but the screen is warped and there is serious light bleed in the hall. People use their phones all the time AND the audience basically randomly walks around. Do not go to a movie here unless you have no other option. || Now it's the only game in town if you want to see a movie. Good theater nice staff old style so the screen isn't like the new theaters but it does the job but they have all the hit movies. The only thing they still have an intermission so it's kind of annoying that they stopped in the middle of the movie and then start again || Worst cinema I have ever been in Israel. 3 halls, we were at num 3 which is the largest The seats and the floor was filthy The screen is very small The audio is terrible The seats themselves are very veryyyyy old Just don't go, better to watch Netflix at home || Although recently recarpeted you can still see the place is in need of renovation. But taking in account that cinemas are dwindling all over the world good it's still open - last cinema and Theatre in Eilat. 3D screening available for selected movies and if you are looking for kids movies most of the time screenings are with and without Hebrew sincronisation || Looks like movies is not a good business in Eilat. No ushers to shoosh the crowd who were all talking during the movie........felt like a lecture hall. And its all down in a cellar and the waitung area looked like a cafeteria! || This is an old-school movie theater, with an intermission in the middle of the movie. We were a little late to the movie and saw a huge line before the  box office. Luckily they started playing about half an hour after the published time, so we got to see everything.

A new and amazing place I have been to quite a few experiences of this theater, the Elad Theater. I highly recommend all the shows!!!!! || A stunning experience and highly recommended! A cast of the highest level, hosted at the Eilat Wine Bar, which is also amazing in its design and menu, provide an evening that is fun, funny, exciting and generally unforgettable. It also has many amusements such as rides,  Lazer, trampoline and gaming centers for kids, Olympic size ice skating ring and all kinds of restaurants. We have one spacious entrance (the cinema only seats 11 people) - and we don't have a buffet... || It's not nice that it's in the fridge, but okay. There's popcorn, unfortunately they add too much salt and it's a shame I had to throw it in the trash. || Not anything at all, maybe for those who haven't experienced it for the first time, it's a nice film of a few minutes. || A really terrible experience, 40 shekels for a short film, terrible sound, completely blurry screen, chairs don't move when they should, for this price you can go see a movie in a movie theater, a waste of money || Hi Almog, I'm sorry this is your experience. The cinema has one of the best sound systems in the world and our projector is a laser technology projector. In the future - I would be happy if you contact us and share your experience with us, first of all so that we can understand if there is a problem, we can check what you felt and why - and whether there was a malfunction or not, we will make sure that you leave feeling good. Right now you are hurt and it's a shame, you are left with a bad taste in your mouth - and you wrote us a review that is the opposite of what we usually receive, which does not indicate anything about the facility (maybe there was something specific that we didn't address, but we will never know).  As they say, lose - lose.

Definitely a must, beautiful,  colorful, sometimes funny, Vegas/ cirque du soleil quality show, and I've seen a bunch. Small, nice. Very interesting to see how this city was developed during this years. One hour, may be one a half 😊 + film. Art gallery is closed for renovations. Good place to visit with children. Recommend it, almost free (very low price) … || Small museum in city center of Eilat. Low entrance price, so conform size of the exhibition. A real fun place for kids, but also for the sea animal lovers. We had a guided tour and it was perfect and well explained. I enjoyed every bit of it. I would have enjoyed more if the glasses were a bit cleaner. Nevertheless, it was fun. PS: The 3D movie was cherry on the top || Would spend there all day. An established place, but it keeps renovating all the time. The shark aquarium is so relaxing and exiting at the same time! The underwater observatory facility is a must. Note- a single ticket is good for a couple of days, so if you want to visit more than once (and you should) plan accordingly. || It is very expensive. The tanks are too small for the large number of fish and turtles. In addition, the glass on the tanks is dirty everywhere, making it difficult to see properly. This needs to be cleaned urgently. The grounds are small overall and half of the attractions consist of films. It is not a must-see. || Good for little kids, probably less for older ones.  The place is trying hard to remain relevant. The underwater observetory is a little old and not really that impressive anymore. However you also get an impressive shark pool and some stingray and sea turtles exhibits. The 3d movie was impressive (but short. 18 min total).  I've certainly been to better aquariums, but this is decent and good for kids. || Wonderful. From walking through the lively coral reef to the 3D cinema which is unlike any other I have witnessed. The screen goes above the head so that it can be protected from any point in the room and looks like the whole is above you. This place is a must see for young and old. It is a beautifully maintained park, with a big variety of coral. The underwater observatory is absolutely amazing. The water of the red see is also accommodating the coral beautifully. The aqua dome is also an experience like none other. The whole is turned into a 3D video and it literally feels like you are under the ocean and touching the sea life yourself. Great place to visit, both educational and fun. its really impressive to see all the unique creatures that live in the ocean. dedicate at least several hours to the visit. || This place gets it!  It's all about the service and people.  Incredibly helpful and friendly staff.  Very clean place.  Food was good and fair priced.  The exhibits were all well maintained.  Especially with children, this is a very nice all day activity. || We’ve been to aquariums all over the world and this isn’t the glossiest or the most high tech. But my kids love it and beg to come back every time we are in Eilat. There’s lots of different things to do that keep everyone entertained and you cannot beat seeing fish in their actual habitat. We love this charming little place. The 3-D movie was a huge hit! || What a great chance to sit and watch fish for hours! Between the underwater observatory and the aquarium we were really pleased with the experience.  Go early for quieter viewing without crowds. There was plenty of parking when they first opened. || We spent the whole day, ~7 hours, so there's lots to do there. I won't give it a 5 star since some things definitely need more love. We saw all the exhibits, there's really a good wide variety and selection of sea creatures, most endemic to Eilat. The highlight must be the shark tank, it has multiple viewing windows, plenty of room, probably the nicest tank I've seen. They feed them twice daily - go to the second feeding! (3pm) it far less crowded. There's a tube to walk under the fish and rays, beautiful. There are also turtles and "rare creatures" (which we didn't find very "rare"). The "deep sea creatures" exhibit is only videos. The lowest point must be the "IMAX", the movie is short, although the 3D effect is cool (kids loved it), but the narration (Heb only) is unintelligible, the content is boring, and they play a "generic" 3D flick. The underwater structure is very nice, but many windows are way too high for a 3-4 y/o to see anything without carrying them 💪, still it's very worth the while (climb up to see the overlook). It's a good place to spend a few hours, it doesn't break the bank, and kids will like it. || Great place to visit. Easy to get to by bus from Eilat. You can buy tickets online or at the gate. The exhibits are lovely.. sharks, stingrays, corals, turtles, octopi, fish. Climb the observatory to the top to see great views of the Red Sea.. then go below sea level to view coral and fish. Try and avoid Jewish / school holidays is it gets very busy. The 3D movie was an extra .. it was not so good.

Very solid beach with beautiful coral reefs. Was super quiet when I went practically empty so was added bonus. Perfect for snorkelling and just general sunbathing. No water sports though. || The world northernmost coral reef, really! Right at your foot steps in eilat, Jordan has none. This beach has the advantage of not being overcrowded and all facilities are here, showers, toilets, bar, and a small nature reserve shop and rental services if you forgot your snorkeling equipment. Note, there are no lifeguard, only park rangers, but there is a space by the beach, in shallow water for poor swimmers Plant to bring some water shoes for the beach side. The reef is accessible via a long pier, and a large staircase leading easily to the water. Then it is the wonders of the red sea! || Although its one of the best places to see corals and fish in Eilat. The site could be a bit more developed. There are not many showers and only one dock to enter the water and relatively small place for swimming. With limited hours of operation and mediocre services this beautiful natural reserve should get an upgrade and the site could invest some of the entrance fee in improvments. || The reserve is well-maintained, clean, and organized, with food shops and equipment rental available. While the price is a bit high compared to free nearby spots, the underwater experience is spectacular- vibrant corals, colorful marine life, and plenty to see.  The area is very accessible, and safety is taken seriously with lifeguards on duty. Showers and restrooms are available and well-kept. Most seating areas are shaded with white canopies, which helps, though it can still get extremely hot in July and August.  Some downsides include ongoing renovations, which limit access to newer sections and make planning a snorkeling route a bit challenging. The designated swimming areas are small and enclosed, but beyond the bridge, there are vast open spaces where you can really explore and see a lot of beautiful marine life.  Overall, it’s more comfortable and enjoyable to snorkel in a well-supervised, maintained area than in unofficial sites, and the beautiful coral and abundant sea creatures make it well worth a visit.  * Pros: Clean and organized, lifeguards on duty, beautiful corals and marine life, showers and restrooms, accessible. * Cons: Entry fee is high compared to free alternatives, renovations limit some areas, enclosed swimming zones can feel small, it can get very hot in summer. || Snorkelling is ok. Nice fish and a bit of coral. If you've been in good reef places, you won't be impressed. But if in Eilat, it's worth a visit but a bit expensive for what it offers. || One of the good beaches in Eilat Clean,  had toilet,  shop,  walk route,  bridge directly to Red see with excitement view of corals, different fish types It's needed some payment,  check possible options before coming there It's better come with your own equipment Pay attention - NO SAFE GUARDS || Our preferred place in Eilat! Every time we are in Eilat we go to this place, the best still and ever.  Actually we were there every day, not a problem as we slept at the Yam Suf Hotel, only a 5 minute walk to there. 1. the beach is incredibly looked after 2. The Reserve guards are watching all the time for trespassers so very little chance something bad could happen to you while swimming 3. and of course the corals and the fish. Yes the coral are less beautiful than in the previous years, the mini tsunami a few years ago did damage the reef, but still they are interesting and the fish are till there and still super beautiful. Don't "FOMO" it, would you? || We had a lovely day out here. It was February, so out of season and not too busy. Lots of beautiful sea life up close in enormous tanks. Also, a very nice undersea viewing room and a sub trip if you want. Loads of facilities and other interesting things to see.....  Lovely and we'll worth a visit 😀 … || Amazing place! Make sure you take snorkels!  For 35 shekel, the place offers quite an experience! A long stretch of white sand, beautiful reefs to snorkel and pretty secure! || The most beautiful marine reserve in the world – colorful gardens beneath the sea The reefs of the Gulf of Eilat are the only coral reefs in our country, and among them a wonderful and colorful world of corals, fish and a huge variety of unique creatures can be seen. The Coral Beach Nature Reserve in Eilat allows visitors easy access to the reef, as well as essential beach services, including a shop, showers, toilets, sunshades, deck chairs and sun loungers

Lasts about 30 minutes and it’s a mix of American top 40 and Israeli music. The lights were just kind of on....the fountains just kind of went up and down....if you’re in the neighbourhood and need somewhere to sit than I’d say go. (And can't be changed) it's 2 shows (same one, twice), one at 8:30pm and one at 9:30pm in an amazing and big parking next to the Eilat museum. Every show is about 20 minutes, starting with movie themes, international hits and then some if the Israeli classics. Lots of space to sit (grass and "stairs") and it's wheelchair eccessible.it's 5 mins walk from the "Hayam" shopping center.dont miss it! || The fountain and music is amazing! I just wish that people will be more considerate of others and not go and stand right at the front to take pictures. That means no one who is sitting on the seats can take a clear photo. Those people in the front are in all of the photos.

We came 5 mins after 12pm (and tickets are valid also tomorrow from the morning only! - as explained on the cash desk); spent some half day here late March; sea temperature fresh but still acceptable; not so crowded today; beach service collect beach chairs regularly; easy to find place and take chairs, we enjoy hot and cold sweets with coffee and fresh Mint lemonade. Really tasty; recommended; next time I repeat. || Amazing ! Such an incredible experience ! Staff are also amazing ! Estelle was great called me told me best times to come ! Mayaan was so welcoming and beautiful and IRa was amazing guide ! She was brilliant and supported me on my first dive ! Dolphins are everywhere ❤️❤️ || For the standard entrance fee you can swim at the beach and spend some time on the pier to film and shoot the dolphins (pier closes at 5 pm). Then you have a bar restaurant upstairs in a wonderful place (forbidden under 18 years old). From this place you still can see the dolphins, enjoy the sun and even stay until 11 pm! || Great place. We did snorkeling with the dolphins, it was great to see them in their natural habitat. Our instructor was a very nice and professional lady that took care of everyone’s comfort and made sure everyone is safe and have an amazing time. I was really scared of the depth but thanks to her I could overcome my fear and enjoy the moment. I can’t thank her enough. It’s a place one of a kind and people there are very welcoming. I highly recommend, worth every penny. || I had a great expirience to dive with dolphins..its something amazing..also the place its like heaven..its diferent than other places that i saw in Israel. The relaxing pools inside its something special too. I recommand everyone to visit. || Wonderful location, really worth the detour even though it's located on the other side of Eilat. There's also a bar inside where you can order drinks and bites. Service was great and the food was delicious. A big 5! || Very clean beach and not too crowded. Dolphins seem happy and free. Very good diving guides, and great service. They even offered us a refund for  for one who couldn't make it on time, because they had another person who was interested to dive instead. || Very beautiful dolphin reef. Tourist attraction. We saw 3 dolphins. The food here was delicious, totally recommend! There are also student fares for entry. || Dolphin Reef in Eilat is a natural habitat of Dolphins. We can observe the dolphins 🐬 from the floating bridge provided. The dolphins are very playful and you are allowed to touch them if you wish to.  The security staff watches over the dolphins as well as feeds them.Some snorkeling facility is also there. We visited long back. The Dolphin Reef is open from Monday to Saturday.  Timings: 9 am to 5 pm. We spent some time observing the dolphins.  There is an entry fee. || The most wonderful beach in Eilat. It’s like a completely different world everything beautiful and clean and pleasant. The food at the beach restaurant is great. And to watch the dolphins is certainly a bonus 🐬 …

The Best Hotel in Eilat for kids!!!!!! There is no other hotel that will take it from U koral beach. Just bring your kid in the morning to the entertainment crew and your kid will be busy all day - amazing! Yes, it pretty far from the main city, but you have everything in the hotel, even beach nearby. I will come back next year! || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed your stay and we look forward to welcoming you back again soon. 🌞 … || I have visited this resort 4 times over the past 27 years (three times in the past five years) and am always happy to return there. The staff are friendly and attentive, the location is excellent - within walking distance of tennis courts, … || I have stayed at U Coral Beach Club multiple times in the past few years with my wife. Overall, it remains one of the most activity-rich hotels in Eilat, but the standards decline each year and might no longer fully justify the price.  Room cleanliness was disappointing. We were upgraded from a Superior U room (the most basic category) to a balcony room, but the upgrade was not worthwhile. Last time we stayed in the Superior U room, and to me it felt newer, cleaner, and had a much nicer bathroom than the balcony room. The balcony room’s bathroom was very small, with a combined tub/shower and only a half glass partition, so water splashed everywhere. The Superior U bathroom, while shower-only, is more spacious and modern. In the balcony room, the tub felt old and not properly cleaned, there was hair on the bed, the sofa bed was opened without request, and there was no water or welcome package in the room..  I would not recommend staying during a storm. Check the weather! The power went out for about half an hour, and roads into and out of Eilat were closed. Reception handled this well and graciously offered us an additional night at a slightly discounted rate (around 10%), which we declined. Instead, they offered a complimentary dinner pass, which was much appreciated.  The food remains a strong point. Dinner was excellent, with a wide and impressive variety: steaks, asado, pulled beef bao buns, schnitzel, chicken dishes, and more. The variety is consistently very good. Breakfast, however, was underwhelming. Limited selection, poor pastries, mediocre orange juice, and only black and green tea available.  The dairy restaurant is very good, but availability is limited to certain days and requires first-come, first-served sign-up. Arriving early is essential.  Unlimited cocktails are fun, but the bar offering is basic. Mostly straight liquors with fruit juices. The slushies are extremely sweet and artificial. Bartender skill varies significantly, though one bartender managed to make a decent piña colada. Drinks are always served in plastic cups, though glass cups can be requested at the indoor bar.  Snorkel rentals and beach equipment are excellent. However, windsurfing is advertised but never seems to happen. On multiple visits there has always been an excuse. This time we were told the instructor had passed away...  I would go again, mainly because no other hotel in Eilat offers this level of activities and programming. That said, for the price, cleanliness, room quality, and overall standards should be higher. || We had the best weekend ever! The bridge too the beach is amazing,food was more than expected so much verity options in every meal! The view from the room was breathtaking, it was fun n relaxing.. thank you || Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! reviews_content: Many varieties of precious and semi precious stones jewely. Highlight on eilat stone. If you go to the center, you can get a discount on glassbottom boat. Very much recommend the tour! Really nice || Thank you so much for your lovely review! We're so happy to hear you enjoyed the tour and had fun riding in the back of the truck — it's definitely part of the adventure! We'll pass your kind words on to Alex — he’ll be thrilled to hear it. And we're glad you liked the tea and pita with labane! You're always welcome back for another journey with us. || Alex was a great guide, and was full of historical and geographical knowledge. The sage tea was wonderful. || Thank you very much for your kind words. I'm glad you enjoyed the tour and the sage tea. It was a pleasure sharing the history and landscapes with you. || We booked a three hours tour and it was great, Alex was very good and the tour was very interesting. Thanks for an amazing adventure. || Thank you for your review. || We had a fantastic tour of the Red Canyon with Alex. He was prompt with pick up, was very charismatic, and his knowledge of the area was incredibly evident. He also knew all the good spots to take pictures, which was very helpful :)  I cannot recommend this tour enough - you won’t be disappointed! || Noa. Thank you very much and good luck. || We were lucky enough to have Alex as our tour guide. His knowledge and insight of the city were easy to follow as we walked our way through The Red Canyon.Alex answered all our questions and even gave a few suggestions on what to do after the tour was over.We would highly recommend this tour and ask for Alex! || Thank you so much! We can’t wait to see you again on your next vacation! || Amazing experience. A jeep ride into the desert on a starry night! Bonus would be if u see wolfs/gazelles! ^_^ Adding some pictures to show you a glimpse of the amazing site.

Very solid beach with beautiful coral reefs. Was super quiet when I went practically empty so was added bonus. Perfect for snorkelling and just general sunbathing. No water sports though. || The world northernmost coral reef, really! Right at your foot steps in eilat, Jordan has none. This beach has the advantage of not being overcrowded and all facilities are here, showers, toilets, bar, and a small nature reserve shop and rental services if you forgot your snorkeling equipment. Note, there are no lifeguard, only park rangers, but there is a space by the beach, in shallow water for poor swimmers Plant to bring some water shoes for the beach side. The reef is accessible via a long pier, and a large staircase leading easily to the water. Then it is the wonders of the red sea! || Although its one of the best places to see corals and fish in Eilat. The site could be a bit more developed. There are not many showers and only one dock to enter the water and relatively small place for swimming. With limited hours of operation and mediocre services this beautiful natural reserve should get an upgrade and the site could invest some of the entrance fee in improvments. || The reserve is well-maintained, clean, and organized, with food shops and equipment rental available. While the price is a bit high compared to free nearby spots, the underwater experience is spectacular- vibrant corals, colorful marine life, and plenty to see.  The area is very accessible, and safety is taken seriously with lifeguards on duty. Showers and restrooms are available and well-kept. Most seating areas are shaded with white canopies, which helps, though it can still get extremely hot in July and August.  Some downsides include ongoing renovations, which limit access to newer sections and make planning a snorkeling route a bit challenging. The designated swimming areas are small and enclosed, but beyond the bridge, there are vast open spaces where you can really explore and see a lot of beautiful marine life.  Overall, it’s more comfortable and enjoyable to snorkel in a well-supervised, maintained area than in unofficial sites, and the beautiful coral and abundant sea creatures make it well worth a visit.  * Pros: Clean and organized, lifeguards on duty, beautiful corals and marine life, showers and restrooms, accessible. * Cons: Entry fee is high compared to free alternatives, renovations limit some areas, enclosed swimming zones can feel small, it can get very hot in summer. || Snorkelling is ok. Nice fish and a bit of coral. If you've been in good reef places, you won't be impressed. But if in Eilat, it's worth a visit but a bit expensive for what it offers. || One of the good beaches in Eilat Clean,  had toilet,  shop,  walk route,  bridge directly to Red see with excitement view of corals, different fish types It's needed some payment,  check possible options before coming there It's better come with your own equipment Pay attention - NO SAFE GUARDS || Our preferred place in Eilat! Every time we are in Eilat we go to this place, the best still and ever.  Actually we were there every day, not a problem as we slept at the Yam Suf Hotel, only a 5 minute walk to there. 1. the beach is incredibly looked after 2. The Reserve guards are watching all the time for trespassers so very little chance something bad could happen to you while swimming 3. and of course the corals and the fish. Yes the coral are less beautiful than in the previous years, the mini tsunami a few years ago did damage the reef, but still they are interesting and the fish are till there and still super beautiful. Don't "FOMO" it, would you? || We had a lovely day out here. It was February, so out of season and not too busy. Lots of beautiful sea life up close in enormous tanks. Also, a very nice undersea viewing room and a sub trip if you want. Loads of facilities and other interesting things to see.....  Lovely and we'll worth a visit 😀 … || Amazing place! Make sure you take snorkels!  For 35 shekel, the place offers quite an experience! A long stretch of white sand, beautiful reefs to snorkel and pretty secure! || The most beautiful marine reserve in the world – colorful gardens beneath the sea The reefs of the Gulf of Eilat are the only coral reefs in our country, and among them a wonderful and colorful world of corals, fish and a huge variety of unique creatures can be seen. The Coral Beach Nature Reserve in Eilat allows visitors easy access to the reef, as well as essential beach services, including a shop, showers, toilets, sunshades, deck chairs and sun loungers

Nice place for a family walk. The promenade is wide, uniform, partly shaded by date palms. Well lighted at night, monitored by several security cameras. Sided by fashion, sports, cafes, restaurants and convenience stores. There's even a public grand piano, so just sit an play. On the sandside, showers, paths for those not willing to walk on the sand and a dancefloor. || Beautiful place for a family walk or a minute of peace alone. || Full of atmosphere and people walking around || Although a small park, it is very nice and quiet. Also, if you want to get a drink there is a small restaurant & pub establishment located in the center of it. || KSP recently moved here from across the street. Good to know! || Barbis burger dinner the best place in Eilat for fast and excellent food and price || Best place to hide from all the tourist and relax in quiet || Easily missable. Quiet and lovely place. || this park is mostly used as a path to Barbi's restaurant || Good time to have in the nature with the family.

A real fun place for kids, but also for the sea animal lovers. We had a guided tour and it was perfect and well explained. I enjoyed every bit of it. I would have enjoyed more if the glasses were a bit cleaner. Nevertheless, it was fun. PS: The 3D movie was cherry on the top || Would spend there all day. An established place, but it keeps renovating all the time. The shark aquarium is so relaxing and exiting at the same time! The underwater observatory facility is a must. Note- a single ticket is good for a couple of days, so if you want to visit more than once (and you should) plan accordingly. || It is very expensive. The tanks are too small for the large number of fish and turtles. In addition, the glass on the tanks is dirty everywhere, making it difficult to see properly. This needs to be cleaned urgently. The grounds are small overall and half of the attractions consist of films. It is not a must-see. || Good for little kids, probably less for older ones.  The place is trying hard to remain relevant. The underwater observetory is a little old and not really that impressive anymore. However you also get an impressive shark pool and some stingray and sea turtles exhibits. The 3d movie was impressive (but short. 18 min total).  I've certainly been to better aquariums, but this is decent and good for kids. || Wonderful. From walking through the lively coral reef to the 3D cinema which is unlike any other I have witnessed. The screen goes above the head so that it can be protected from any point in the room and looks like the whole is above you. This place is a must see for young and old. It is a beautifully maintained park, with a big variety of coral. The underwater observatory is absolutely amazing. The water of the red see is also accommodating the coral beautifully. The aqua dome is also an experience like none other. The whole is turned into a 3D video and it literally feels like you are under the ocean and touching the sea life yourself. Great place to visit, both educational and fun. its really impressive to see all the unique creatures that live in the ocean. dedicate at least several hours to the visit. || This place gets it!  It's all about the service and people.  Incredibly helpful and friendly staff.  Very clean place.  Food was good and fair priced.  The exhibits were all well maintained.  Especially with children, this is a very nice all day activity. || We’ve been to aquariums all over the world and this isn’t the glossiest or the most high tech. But my kids love it and beg to come back every time we are in Eilat. There’s lots of different things to do that keep everyone entertained and you cannot beat seeing fish in their actual habitat. We love this charming little place. The 3-D movie was a huge hit! || What a great chance to sit and watch fish for hours! Between the underwater observatory and the aquarium we were really pleased with the experience.  Go early for quieter viewing without crowds. There was plenty of parking when they first opened. || We spent the whole day, ~7 hours, so there's lots to do there. I won't give it a 5 star since some things definitely need more love. We saw all the exhibits, there's really a good wide variety and selection of sea creatures, most endemic to Eilat. The highlight must be the shark tank, it has multiple viewing windows, plenty of room, probably the nicest tank I've seen. They feed them twice daily - go to the second feeding! (3pm) it far less crowded. There's a tube to walk under the fish and rays, beautiful. There are also turtles and "rare creatures" (which we didn't find very "rare"). The "deep sea creatures" exhibit is only videos. The lowest point must be the "IMAX", the movie is short, although the 3D effect is cool (kids loved it), but the narration (Heb only) is unintelligible, the content is boring, and they play a "generic" 3D flick. The underwater structure is very nice, but many windows are way too high for a 3-4 y/o to see anything without carrying them 💪, still it's very worth the while (climb up to see the overlook). It's a good place to spend a few hours, it doesn't break the bank, and kids will like it. || Great place to visit. Easy to get to by bus from Eilat. You can buy tickets online or at the gate. The exhibits are lovely.. sharks, stingrays, corals, turtles, octopi, fish. Climb the observatory to the top to see great views of the Red Sea.. then go below sea level to view coral and fish. Try and avoid Jewish / school holidays is it gets very busy. The 3D movie was an extra .. it was not so good.

My favorite place in Eilat. || Very interesting place, with very interesting creatures. Please just look and don't touch or take creatures out of the water, it might kill them. Ohhh and watch where you are stepping. :) || Good place to see hand made coral reef. Be aware of stone fish! || I think this place is out of service..at least it looked like it. || We were there in the evening for work. The place is nice but they played music at a deafening volume and it was really unpleasant. Other than that, it was a very nice place. You can splash around in the water while sitting on the rocks. || A lovely place to see the variety of animals in the Karit. This is a unique area where the tides dictate special adaptations to the creatures. Mollusks, crabs, fish, chitons and what not. It's all there. Highly recommended for nature lovers who understand the subject. || An amazing stretch of coast - allows for urban nature, an innovative concept that exists in several places in the country that maintains a nature reserve within the urban life of the city of Eilat. Definitely a gem worth a visit, I was there as a guide for the Society for the Protection of Nature and she presented a broad picture and explanations of the marine animals || Beautiful and interesting especially when the sea is low. You can see various marine animals. Recommended! || Nice place.... Quiet and comfortable atmosphere. Anyone who wants to clear their head and relax this is the right place!!!!

This is a really amazing place to learn about the bird migration through Israel and why it happens. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and it is certainly worth taking their guided tour. They will only allow guided tours with the Ornithologists who work there so it will always be great. There are many different things to see and hear about so make sure to leave yourself a bit of time. || ONLY INTERESTING WITH A TOUR GUIDE UR EXPERT!! There's simply nothing nothing to see by yourself || Very nice place for wildlife and also very nice park to walk and to enjoy nature. I was in december 2018 which is probably not the best month for wild birds, but I still found a lot of interesting species. I attached some pictures with the birds I found there. || The best place for birding Ng and making new experiences. Professional staff around and many interesting people are coming from around the world. The place is real heaven of birds and attracts birders and just nature lovers from around the world. The place is highly recommended to see. || I recommend driving a car there. We were there 20.02 and we didn't see any interesting birds. I think it's only for people who are interested im birds, nature. Or you have to be when it's season for egzotic birds. The biggest advantage is free entry. || Really nice, clean and welcoming, a bunch of birds,plants and insects. Also have a few mini lakes and rivers. There is a nice short trail with information about the place, plants and birds. Good for kids.  Dogs are welcome on a leash, there are public restrooms and a small souvenir store. || Enjoyed the place soo much and stayed there for along time if you are visiting eilat and you would like to see something unusual and not just going to swim this is the place normally it's free of charge to enter there but if you would like to have a guide you need to pay around 35nis which is fair for a very good guide in English or Hebrew and the money for sure is for researching and I really enjoy it || Interesting and peaceful place. I had no binoculars but still was able to see some nice birds. Worth visiting - entrance is free. || a very nice "nature" walk with benches to  sit relax and watch some birds. not many birds (January). but still worth it. free and open all day. || Were there in spring to watch migrating birds. Unfortunatly we had bad wether for photography. But the birds were there

Best suited for snorkeling.  Even if you don't know swimming you can  rent the snorkeling face  equipment and just use it next to the beach to view the amazing corals and beautiful fishes. || You might be able to peek here and there at the reef. Not the entire area is accessible to public. They have a 750m long lane accessible with bridges for swimming, snorkeling and scuba diving (bring your own gear- though they might rent if needed - at least snorkeling). Not really food option but it’s a nice bring your own food stay by the beach kind of place. There is a supermarket across from the road where parking is free and where you can get goodies.  Amenities are sparse but that is fine. || Amazing beach. So fun jumping off the deck! Really gorgeous views and access to marine life. Free beach and they offer lounge chairs and snacks! || Very cool beach, only with rocks and perfect for snorkeling and diving. Location well equipped with bar, umbrellas and deckchairs. || Great beach for snorkeling. Gear rental on site. Picnic tables, shade and food. || Heaven for snorkelling, especially for nervous snorkellers: they have designed a snorkelling 'route' around the reef with a rope you can use for guidance and feeling a bit more secure. The marine life is amazing with huge colourful fish. They rope of the main reef to protect it from damage from selfish tourists, but you can still see it from the edge. Beach has plenty of shade and chairs. All equipment and lockers available. Take your own food  as all you can get here are french fries or frozen pizza they heat up. You can get here by a 5 minute bus from the main area of Eilat. || Very well organized for snorkeling but maybe too much... in the water you can’t really get close to the corals and there are many people at the same place so not so wild as you could expect. || Great experience. Lots of space to sit. The snorkelling was great fun and there were lots and lots of fish. || Good facilities with snorkel hire, locker hire, shower, toilets etc. However, you have to view the coral in a guided lane, which is very restrictive. The coral is better in other places along the coast, but there was a decent variety of fish to see. || It's a place with shower, toilets, diving equipment to rent, shops and more. There public bus lines getting you from any point of Eilat to this Nature Reserve Beach. In Hebrew: חוף האלמוג Hof Halmog. The beach is huge and very clean. Wonderful for sea nature lovers because there you can see all the sea life just getting in the sea. The Red Sea waters are an spectacle for the clear swimming, good temperature and the lack of waves that allow you to see all the amazing under water life. The entrance is not free. You may need to call to know opening hours and entry ticket prices.

A really nice place suitable for young children. What I liked least was that the park is not fenced. || An interesting park for children, a science park, although not a large area, but nice to spend time in. || Amazing place, great facilities, the only problem is that this is the only park in Eilat that is invested like this, I wish there were more parks and fitness facilities in Eilat || A wonderful park for everyone, especially those with special needs in wheelchairs and more. The park has accessible swings, an accessible ladder, a spinning top, lawns and more. The park is shaded, with benches and water fountains. Free accessible parking, no restrooms on site. || Lovely place, great facilities. Looks clean and well maintained. || Also called "Science Garden". Two adjacent gardens, separated by a small field. The first (eastern) garden has quite a few facilities, but mainly for younger children, 4 and under. The Science Garden has unusual facilities such as a helicopter and a moon jump. We were with children aged 4, 7 and 9 on the day of the Omer - for some reason they woke up at 7 am and we had to wait until things opened. Very nice. The shading in the Science Garden itself is less successful, it is better to arrive early in the morning or late in the afternoon. Overall nice and free, not hysterically exciting but the little customers were satisfied || The accessible park, a special place, a park with facilities that allow everyone to experience, innovative facilities adapted and accessible. Most of the day, families, groups of children come, spending hours in pure enjoyment. An amazing park

A very large and beautiful park. The entire park is grass. There is a playground in the evening. Dog owners can interact with the dogs. There is an adjacent dog park. Beautiful lighting. A basketball court. A clean place with statues and lots of seating. || Beautiful and well-kept park || Excellent meeting place

We came 5 mins after 12pm (and tickets are valid also tomorrow from the morning only! - as explained on the cash desk); spent some half day here late March; sea temperature fresh but still acceptable; not so crowded today; beach service collect beach chairs regularly; easy to find place and take chairs, we enjoy hot and cold sweets with coffee and fresh Mint lemonade. Really tasty; recommended; next time I repeat. || Amazing ! Such an incredible experience ! Staff are also amazing ! Estelle was great called me told me best times to come ! Mayaan was so welcoming and beautiful and IRa was amazing guide ! She was brilliant and supported me on my first dive ! Dolphins are everywhere ❤️❤️ || For the standard entrance fee you can swim at the beach and spend some time on the pier to film and shoot the dolphins (pier closes at 5 pm). Then you have a bar restaurant upstairs in a wonderful place (forbidden under 18 years old). From this place you still can see the dolphins, enjoy the sun and even stay until 11 pm! || Great place. We did snorkeling with the dolphins, it was great to see them in their natural habitat. Our instructor was a very nice and professional lady that took care of everyone’s comfort and made sure everyone is safe and have an amazing time. I was really scared of the depth but thanks to her I could overcome my fear and enjoy the moment. I can’t thank her enough. It’s a place one of a kind and people there are very welcoming. I highly recommend, worth every penny. || I had a great expirience to dive with dolphins..its something amazing..also the place its like heaven..its diferent than other places that i saw in Israel. The relaxing pools inside its something special too. I recommand everyone to visit. || Wonderful location, really worth the detour even though it's located on the other side of Eilat. There's also a bar inside where you can order drinks and bites. Service was great and the food was delicious. A big 5! || Very clean beach and not too crowded. Dolphins seem happy and free. Very good diving guides, and great service. They even offered us a refund for  for one who couldn't make it on time, because they had another person who was interested to dive instead. || Very beautiful dolphin reef. Tourist attraction. We saw 3 dolphins. The food here was delicious, totally recommend! There are also student fares for entry. || Dolphin Reef in Eilat is a natural habitat of Dolphins. We can observe the dolphins 🐬 from the floating bridge provided. The dolphins are very playful and you are allowed to touch them if you wish to.  The security staff watches over the dolphins as well as feeds them.Some snorkeling facility is also there. We visited long back. The Dolphin Reef is open from Monday to Saturday.  Timings: 9 am to 5 pm. We spent some time observing the dolphins.  There is an entry fee. || The most wonderful beach in Eilat. It’s like a completely different world everything beautiful and clean and pleasant. The food at the beach restaurant is great. And to watch the dolphins is certainly a bonus 🐬 …

Super Friendly and professional team, beautiful sunset by the Red Sea, peaceful Mush beach and challenging yoga session. DON’T MISS OUT !! Thank you Yoga Eilat || Thank you very muchhhhhhhhhh Namaste || Non Yogic approach, defiantly would have saved myself the unpleasant communication if I would have known. I send this alert with kindness. || Wonderful teacher and class! I came from out of town and luckily stumbled upon this gem. Tough with a smile! But a tough one .. a teacher who is beyond all imagination and your success &&& A big thank you to get to know || Amazing leader! Instills calmness, and knows how to give everyone a great feeling, even if you are a beginner and inexperienced. An amazing teacher with an understanding of the body and a true love for yoga and students. And in addition to all this - choosing amazing locations for training. || Beloved Leader❤️ Thank you for the amazing lessons that taught me the asanas, that opened up a world for me to more wonderful yoga streams. Thank you for making my vacation an amazing vacation. You managed to reinforce what I already knew that there is nothing like yoga and how important perseverance is to strengthen the body and mind🧘‍♀️ So thank you so much I enjoyed every moment until the next vacation I wish you lots of joy and satisfaction from what you do because it is amazing❤️ || Thank you Sivan, see you next vacation You are charming yourself  Www.yogaeilat.com || I was at the Shark Pool Yoga morning with Eilat Yoga, although there are no pictures but you can assume it was perfect!  Many thanks to Idan and Shahar, the instructors, for the excellent session, the guidance and the personal attention to each of the participants ❤️ || Reserve 20/10 We are waiting for you || A yoga class with Leader is more than just a workout, it's a treatment for the body and mind. Great place, great teachers. Highly recommended for vinayasa and aerial yoga. || I came with my partner for a Shadow Yoga class during our vacation in Eilat. Lovely and beautiful studio, well equipped, and the yoga class was excellent and professional. Thank you very much! We will definitely be back on our next vacation. || I arrived on vacation in Eilat, missing my regular yoga practice. I heard about the studio and immediately contacted Yael. The kindness, in the stunning studio, the atmosphere, the diversity of the classes and above all the professionalism of the guidance made the practice a unique experience. I left feeling euphoric 😀 There is no doubt that every time I come to Eilat I will come to practice at the studio. Namaste Yifat 🙏 || Thank you Yifat, it was fun having you come! See you...:-)) || I came to Eilat for a short vacation. I chose to try a class with Yaeli at the Fly with the Body studio. The experience was very good. I felt that the instructions were clear and that Yael was always aware of my postures and corrected me professionally when needed. After the class, I felt that my body was really open, and my back pain disappeared for a few days. I highly recommend it to anyone who comes to Eilat to try it and take part 🙏🏻 || The perfect place for yoga in Eilat🙏🏽🌷 Calm, peaceful and a pleasant atmosphere. I've been practicing with Yaeli for six months now and there's nothing more relaxing than her🙏🏽All the instructors are professional and the attitude is very personal ❤️ || Yaeli is amazing, explains and demonstrates every pose And all the teachers in the studio are professional! Yoga becomes a super experience Really fly with the body and mind || International level professionalism. Such a pleasant practice and perfect atmosphere || An addictive place, a place of sanity in a world of chaos, professional teachers, immense diversity, aesthetic and pleasant, in short, perfect ♥️ || High-level professional studio Yael is an amazing instructor🙏 || Stunning and professional yoga studio, amazing atmosphere, highly recommended

place_name: ניצן ביבס- YOGA NOW | Nitzan Bivas | יוגה באילת
reviews_content: I practiced yoga with Nitzan for a long time, Nitzan is an attentive and connected teacher. The practice with her is flowing, pleasant, caring and conscious. I felt that she emphasized the physical and mental aspects of the class, precise in the movement and paying attention to small details. As well as on the mental aspect, she gave space and attention to the way in which each person comes to the practice and added elements that helped connect with nature and yourself. || Nitzan is a magical girl who teaches yoga in a professional, clear and pleasant way. I really enjoyed participating in the 21-day Yoga and Gratitude program. The program gave me a connection to myself, calmness, peace and acceptance. I highly recommend the practices with the stunning Nitzan🩷 … || Nitzan is one of the most beautiful gifts I have given myself. I came to her with terrible lower back pain, apparently caused by prolonged sitting. After just a few months, the back pain is gone. Furthermore, Nitzan incorporates a lot of mindfulness into her treatment, the sweet fruits of which are calmness, a significant reduction in the anxieties I was subject to, and an end to the insomnia I had. The correct posture and toned body I received are just the bonus. Highly recommended! ( || Practicing with Nitz is simply relaxing and opens the heart. Her approach to accepting what is, loving what is, and a lot of patience for the process are essential for the feeling of progress. Enjoyed the practice and the energy of the place! Really kind staff of teachers! I will note that I personally felt uncomfortable with the instructor's "small" and "accidental" touches - and not only during the class, but also at the end - so if you are a young and pleasant-looking girl - be careful and keep your distance (well, now in the days of Corona it will be easier with that) - but the yoga itself was actually really fine. It is worth coming to anyone who loves yoga and comes to Eilat. || Very beautiful place, amazing and warm people, and it's just amazing to be there, highly recommended. || A magical, relaxing, pleasant and very high-quality place, highly recommended to anyone who wants an improvement in the quality of life, with peace and tranquility that are so essential to us always and especially these days. || Excellent place. The perfect way to finish the day.
