The alcohol is pretty expensive, but it makes sense to the position of the restaurant. || Evening review: nice atmosphere. Calm and relaxing music. Menu is good (simple food but sometimes it's exactly what you need). What we didn't like: waiter (name starts with D) had 2 mistakes in bill (total mistake value of about 25 USD). We told him and he canceled just one of them. Refused the other was a mistake. Shame because otherwise nice place. Prices are decent though. || Summery: good place for a group who want different kinds of dishes. Food is good, prices are reasonable.  There is only one way to describe the food- OK. Its not bad in any way, tasty to eat even, but not exceptional in any way. I can say this after tasting everyone's dishes, and after asking them. This place is really a jack of all trades but master of none, which is great if you have a big family that wants different things (like us).  Service is great: fast, professional, kind. Cant ask for more.  Atmosphere is great, lighting, music, the option to sit by the sea (we didn't) is all very attractive || Honestly we didn’t expect much and were looking for a spot by the water. But the food is just great!! Really amazing experience, was really full when we arrived but fortunately we got a table. Prices are average for Eilat. || Nice place for breakfast and dinner! Restaurant and seats just few feets from the sea. Prices are good. Breakfast for one was very good and cost about 15€. Burger was ok, price about 16€. Breakfast for two adults and a three year old child cost us 150 NIS. That was about 35€. Well recommended! || The food and service were perfect, I would reccomend coming at a decent hour (19:00-21:00) before rush hour to actually test the waters, Our waitress (Ziv) was spectacular, she was super welcoming and fast with eyecontact service, she came with all of our food at once. Very calming music, super cute I would recommend this place for a date, dinner with friends, familly outing and even meetings. || Recommended! When you are on the beach, go and have some drink! We picked mango cosmopolitan - good one, and Nine beach speciality, i dont really remember the name of the drink, but it was mojito with watermelon and kiwi twist - best one! It really tastes great 😍 and the cakes, oh, no words needed. Staff was nice, attentive, also when i asked if they have gluten free cakes, the waiter recommended me some, and went to double check with the chef, without my request - which I found really nice! In Israel is food more expensive, so don't be surprised if your bill is higher lol. || So the location and overall vibe are simply stellar! Music is good and a normal volume (which is rare for these kinda beach bars). But the service is simply horrible! I took a seat and they were quick to give me a menu and a drink but they never returned after that. I even asked them to take my order and the waitress said; "one minute" and never returned. To make it even worse; the waitress was constantly chatting with what appeared to be her personal friends a table next to me for nearly an hour!

Barama Lounge Buffet with delicious rotating food Always clean and with a good atmosphere || A 5-star hotel in every sense, rooms with spacious clean showers, towel service immediately as needed. Delicious meals with a huge selection, accompanied by a chef and waiter who immediately clears the table until your plate is bursting with content as you can. Going to the sea and the promenade, which is open until the night, even on weekends. Some of the shops are open. You can order tickets at the reception for all cultural activities in each hotel. It is recommended to take into account the rates for a jacuzzi of 90 NIS or a sauna of 380 NIS per person with advance booking. Option to choose the type of sauna. I recommend checking the ticket type when buying on the website, some of them VIP, including a lounge, a type of restaurant open from 9 am all day for a meal and alcoholic drinks, so entry is only for those over 16. A games room on site with a fee for each game. || Good quality lounge, the food is very tasty and varied. Large variety of cold alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks Very polite and helpful staff Highly recommended for those staying at the Royal Beach Hotel Eilat

Best suited for snorkeling.  Even if you don't know swimming you can  rent the snorkeling face  equipment and just use it next to the beach to view the amazing corals and beautiful fishes. || You might be able to peek here and there at the reef. Not the entire area is accessible to public. They have a 750m long lane accessible with bridges for swimming, snorkeling and scuba diving (bring your own gear- though they might rent if needed - at least snorkeling). Not really food option but it’s a nice bring your own food stay by the beach kind of place. There is a supermarket across from the road where parking is free and where you can get goodies.  Amenities are sparse but that is fine. || Amazing beach. So fun jumping off the deck! Really gorgeous views and access to marine life. Free beach and they offer lounge chairs and snacks! || Very cool beach, only with rocks and perfect for snorkeling and diving. Location well equipped with bar, umbrellas and deckchairs. || Great beach for snorkeling. Gear rental on site. Picnic tables, shade and food. || Heaven for snorkelling, especially for nervous snorkellers: they have designed a snorkelling 'route' around the reef with a rope you can use for guidance and feeling a bit more secure. The marine life is amazing with huge colourful fish. They rope of the main reef to protect it from damage from selfish tourists, but you can still see it from the edge. Beach has plenty of shade and chairs. All equipment and lockers available. Take your own food  as all you can get here are french fries or frozen pizza they heat up. You can get here by a 5 minute bus from the main area of Eilat. || Very well organized for snorkeling but maybe too much... in the water you can’t really get close to the corals and there are many people at the same place so not so wild as you could expect. || Great experience. Lots of space to sit. The snorkelling was great fun and there were lots and lots of fish. || Good facilities with snorkel hire, locker hire, shower, toilets etc. However, you have to view the coral in a guided lane, which is very restrictive. The coral is better in other places along the coast, but there was a decent variety of fish to see. || It's a place with shower, toilets, diving equipment to rent, shops and more. There public bus lines getting you from any point of Eilat to this Nature Reserve Beach. In Hebrew: חוף האלמוג Hof Halmog. The beach is huge and very clean. Wonderful for sea nature lovers because there you can see all the sea life just getting in the sea. The Red Sea waters are an spectacle for the clear swimming, good temperature and the lack of waves that allow you to see all the amazing under water life. The entrance is not free. You may need to call to know opening hours and entry ticket prices.

place_name: מסעדת מיה ביץ - מסעדת בשרים כשרה
reviews_content: The menu at  Mia Beach Bar is a true culinary masterpiece. Every dish is meticulously prepared with the finest ingredients, resulting in a symphony of flavors that will tantalize your taste buds. From the first bite to the last, each dish was a delightful revelation. The menu features a diverse range of options, catering to various dietary preferences and ensuring there is something for everyone to savor. || Hot beer in a plastic cup. Dusty plates. A waiter who, when serving dishes, dips his sweater into the sauces on the table. Soy sauce seems to be bottled ten years ago.  Do you think this is unrealistic?  This happened to me today.  Why two stars and not one - they have really good sushi. || Good,loud music and that’s all. Sushi is manageable, salads over dressed, hot drinks in plastic cups. Service is awful, the worst I saw since. A bunch of waiters are walking up and down disoriented. At the end the bill came wrong with things we didn’t order. Good as a bar, but not as a restaurant. And defenetly is not a place for kids! || very nice place right next to the beach in the tourists zone, the food is very tasty and fresh, the portions are good, all that along with music from the 80s make it a perfect place for dinner or a drink. I will surely revisit this place next time I'm in Eilat. || Not sure if it's new here or not but when we were there it was mainly a sushi place named Jiro and also they had Susu burgers (for those from the center) sushi is average but I'd say overpriced compared to other places. || Food was decent. Although we had not a very nice service. I asked for a certain bottle of dry wine, it was not available. We were offered to choose between 2 different bottle, we chose one, tried it and it was not dry, although I asked for dry. I do not read Hebrew very well so I couldn’t read what was written on the bottle. After we found out we asked to replace the bottle or find some other kind of compromise, cause it was mutual mistake. The waitress just refused to do anything, we didn’t even get a simple sorry. So in general unpleasant experience. || Foods was delicious ambiance was perfect  workers was kind really satisfied this place exactly i will come back again || good location but ...expensive as it often is the case with beach restaurants. Still a nice and enjoyable place to be || Very good location by the beach. Lovely waiter. But his kind attitude couldn't save the place. It could be a good restaurant with cool vibes, but it seems like they just don't care. Dirty, neglected exterior space. Menu with non-existing food and drinks.  It's very unfortunate... || Cool bar located right on the shore of the Red Sea in Eilat. I was there in the mid-afternoon, sat on the beach, the service was great but not evasive. I visited in Israeli 'winter' but I'm sure it's a go-to place when the weather warms up! Check it out!

I was there as a guest of the Red Sea hotel which offers as a bundle 20% discount at this restaurant and free sunbeds. I'd say it was very good if it weren't for the music which was way too loud at all time and eventually rather tiring if not worse. One can't bear so much for wailing middle eastern music nor excessive on steroids' bass of rap  music || Nice atmosphere, very close to water attractions for those interested, such as parasailing, tubing, boat trips, and more. The cocktails are delicious, and the staff is really friendly || Beautiful place on the beach to relax with cocktails and have a dip in the Sea, watching the boats come in and out of the harbour. Nigila available, as well as meals and snacks. || Great Place. Delicious food. Friendly staff. The only thing I did not like was the construction fence around this place but this was nothing the restaurant could change, so no star taking down for this :-) Be prepared, we will come again! || Nice and calm beach  The bech is very clean and have no waves, so you can sweem as much as you want. The chairs on the beach arent free (as inall eilat beaches). Price for chair: 12 shhekels for one.  I didnt like only on thing: the beach is very close to water sports place. The water sports boats are always moveing and it pollute a lot of  noise. || Great place for a beer. Reasonable prices At night it lures young people for singing contests, music is noisy. Tge restrooms are not part of the place, and are public and therefor stink... || My visit there was very pleasant, only 20₪ for a tanning bed (one time payment) for a person, awesome spot for a nice relaxing time, near the beach. Unfortunately, the prices of the food and drinks are high as the sky. Fries with fruit milkshake (which wasn’t tasty I must say) and a cocktail costed me 120₪ which I think is a lot for the value of the product’s quality I received. || A place where fraers are respected.  In Hebrew, when paying on the check, it is indicated that it includes a tip of 12%.  Then, in English, it says in capital letters that the check DOES NOT INCLUDE TIPS… || Disaster place ,an old man on a bar doesn’t know how to talk with this customers, I ask him a regular water from the sink and he told me that he cannot give me because everyone need to pay for a regular water from the sink because they’re paying for it and paying for the cup so he cannot give me for free! He told me go to the restroom and get from there the water and even the cup he didn’t want to give me, only the waiter gave me water in the end! I have no idea how this kind of mail that doesn’t know how to go. His customers is still working in this tourist place. after all, I went to the owner of this place and told him about the situation with this old man she talk to me in a disgusting way same to me. I don’t owe you nothing I’m not supposed to give you cups for free, you have to pay for it if this place don’t care about their customers and don’t know how to give service so I wish them good luck. actually the worst restaurant experience that I ever had in my life. when the owner is saying to me that is only one weapon that I can use against him saying about my experience in Google so it means I’m gonna use this if he doesn’t hear what his customers is saying to him and he doesn’t want to chang anything in his restaurant || Too dark place with nice music and slow service. I got cold meat plate that coast as a hot one. Food is eatble, not at restaurant level. Bear comes cold. Not so bad

Service above and beyond! Lidor the professional prepared our dishes and was very considerate and sensitive to our requests.. And most importantly, delicious and clean food! Highly recommended for a light meal || I ordered shakshuka, asked for an extra 2 eggs, they charged me another 8 shekels per dish, I paid with love, then I asked for some black olives to be added to the shakshuka, they asked for another 4 shekels, simply impudence, the behavior of robbers and a disdainful attitude. The food was delicious, the experience was less. || We had a light breakfast The food was fresh, served clean and tidy The staff did everything quickly, Good atmosphere, It's inside the mall, Sit down to eat and enjoy. || Relatively bad, there's a guy who pretends to work near a place called Corn, who bet on work, so he doesn't work at his place, who disrespects the politeness of me asking the cashier instead, who bet on an employee who doesn't work at the place. || Disgusting pizza. The only thing good about it is the spices. || Expensive prices, disrespectful attitude. And needless to say, poor customer service that is lacking!!! This morning I asked to order a double espresso from the guy at the cafe wifi stand in Ace opposite Eilat And I must say that for the first time in my life I encountered unrelated questions from the seller such as short espresso, long double long and then I told him only double espresso and I encountered a rude answer from the guy at the stand and I quote him "You know what I'm closed now I'm not making you" Simply shame and a certificate of poverty for a place that already measured up. Not recommended at all!!! || Reasonable self-assembled toast. Reasonable prices. || Excellent service, good and personal attitude, highly recommended, of course I will come back. || First of all, bad service, the food is not tasty at all and a disrespectful attitude || Horrible place, terrible service, do not recommend

Love the Cream express! Delicious fresh breakfast and sandwiches. Interesting mix of customers, including locals, tourists, pensioners, hippies and bus drivers. Very accommodating. What a local cafe should be. Open from morning to early afternoon. || Attractive prices (9 ILS for espresso macchiato), good service, coffee is just okay. Atmosphere leaves a little to be desired -- only few tables in the air conditioned area. || Our breakfast was delicious and the guys here were very friendly || I came to eilat after a long bus trip ,looking for a great place to eat , 5 min from the bus station  i found it . a cozy  small restaurant with a huge terrace , great food , even for vegan, all handmade with love , great chill out  and not exspensive. Crema Express is the place for me , great food , friendly owner , all made with love , very friendly to tourists. || Fresh and tasty food. Super-friendly service. One of the best coffees ever! I recommend the croissant with  egg, salmon, and cheese -- a super generous serving that was really delicious. || Amazing service and amazing food! The staff was very personable and friendly. Food was plentiful and really good! There is outdoor and indoor seating. If youre visiting Eilat I highly recommend going to crema express! || Friendly service. Tasty food. || Amazing food, amazing prices, amazing vibes, perfect place. Amazing service too!! || Coffee quality was very good. Croissant was fresh. Staff spoke English. || Great food for a great price. Lovely staff with awesome vibes. Will definately go again. || Thank you very much .

This is one of the most amazing Cafes in Eilat and it's in the best hotel! The coffee is delicious ☕️ (better than Aroma!) and the breakfast was first-class! All the juices are fresh and wonderful. The waitress and serve was perfect and fast. We can't wait to enjoy our next breakfast again 🎉 … || We were very happy with their coffee (both espresso and ice coffee) and nice strawberry tart. The atmosphere is very nice, especially at the tables outside. The service has some room for improvement. || The beetroot and orange juice is excellent. I had fish and chips. Everyone enjoyed their dish. The bread sticks with cheese and spinach is also really good. || High-quality food at a relatively high gastronomic level. However, the service not adequate to  enjoy the place. The dishing arrived not in a good synchronization, moreover, the waiters are not sympathetic. We wait a long time to put the order, and then my dish comes first, after half an hour when we were asked what happens with my wife's plate, they bring it! || Very friendly staff, has table service so feels very relaxed. Full menu for food, as well as baked goods. The cappuccino I had was delicious. Multiple staff members spoke both English and Hebrew || Delicious, divine friendly service, beautiful place, very nice atmosphere. || Service wad bad The waiter didn’t take care of us and took much time to service us || Excellent atmosphere ! || A restaurant that we visit often, partly due to the quality and service that were part of the experience. Unfortunately, this is the second time in a row that we have encountered service that is below all criticism. It seems that the waiters are not adequately trained, and a new manager who repeatedly repeats answers of “I don’t have it” and “I’m not allowed”, without any real attempt to provide an answer or solution. When you add to this a price that does not justify the overall experience, the disappointment is great. Very unfortunate and very disappointing

Since I got there, I haven't eaten at Aroma anymore! The pastries are high quality and fresh and the breakfasts are excellent, in general there is a pleasant atmosphere with calm music and the service is always with a smile. What surprised me is that the price is also cheap on top of all that. I will just say that because there are not many employees, it may take a while before they turn to you, but that is only a point. || Thank you very much🙏  … || Fresh and delicious pastries! Perfect coffee. 💗 || Excellent service. Delicious food, recommend their bakery. || Thank you very much 🙏 … || New owner.home made pastry.feeling great.New owners, amazing energy, everything turquoise, fresh pastries baked on site, homemade recipe, not frozen, baked here in Eilat. I finally found a decent place both socially and in terms of menu... || There's a girl working here who scratched the Tesla || Very nice place, delicious pastries. || Thank you, Alina, come again, we will try to continue to delight you with delicious things || Great place, good service, wonderful people, delicious buns, you can order all sorts of goodies in advance.

Aroma, a good value as always, and such is this one, a typical Aroma coffee shop but with a splendid view on the Red Sea.  Like the other ones in this chain it offers cheap price, large portions, very fast service: we had a salad which was big enough for both of us. Coffee was good, such as the brownies as dessert. And no problems whatsoever with the Tuna Salad. This restaurant is situated right on the beach, a gorgeous view on the beach and the sea with no impact whatsoever on the prices which are the same than the other ones in the chain. The sunset is beautiful on the red sea although the sun doesn't sink in the sea. I'll attach some pictures of the surroundings... Not for gourmet certainly, but for families it is perfect.. || Outstanding food. The pastries stole the show. We had a greek sandwich and a traditional Israeli breakfast. But the pastires absolutely were the best of all || Great location, nice decor and good service. Pity they ruined it by serving yesterday's vegetable salad at breakfast today. || Amazing food and drinks. The view is gorgeous if you decide to sit outside. Very tasty Israeli 🇮🇱 food. || I give it 5 stars because of good localization, great pastries and coffee, and prices not significantly higher than in different places. We’ve had one of the best coffees in Eilat there and have not eaten such tasty pastries before. A nice place to seat in and nice outdoor balcony. Moreover the ordering is very convenient because it’s digitalized and the service is very fast. Worth going! || We originally wanted to order a takeout but decided to stay, the food came quickly and was very delicious || I came for a morning coffee , It was tasty and all but I was disappointed to find out they serve cold coffee in disposable plastic cups.  Besides this, the place is located at a lovely location with a view of the seaside . || Salad was huge but had some stuff that didn't feel fresh || I’m a big critic when it comes to coffee .. strong cappuccino made perfect 👌🏼 || Nice place by the ocean 🌊 Not a personal Caffe More of a come in get out But tasty and friendly Good for groups and singles. I'd come

Amazing team, super helpful and always full of a contagious joy. That together with the amazing food. Definitely worth coming back!!! || Excellent service and good preparation. Better then aroma in Tel Aviv! || The only Aroma branch at Eilat where it is possible to have a breakfast before 08:00 a.m. || We were delighted to find a Kosher Aroma in Eilat. Salad was delicious and very attractively presented. || Great place and located comfy, Food and beverage super. Coffee 👍🏻👍🏻 || Just seat relax and enjoy of good cup of coffee. || Sandwich, coffee and juices, for a quick bite to eat || Great place for having a rest from the heat outside. || The service is fast and the food is served with a smile. The salads and sandwiches are fresh and come in large portions. || The kitchen was closed due to congestion The amazing saleswoman saw that I was pregnant and opened it especially for me. Just service above and beyond Tasty, aesthetic and ready quickly

What a wonderful stay! We originally had 2 rooms booked for us and our 2 children. Upon arrival the wonderful Shai offered us to upgrade to a suite and how wonderful it was! We were on the 12th floor with an outdoor jacuzzi which we enjoyed … || Had a great experience at the Queen of Sheba Hotel in Eilat, especially thanks to Abed Hakim in the Club House Lounge on the 12th floor. Abed was super friendly, helpful, and really made us feel taken care of. He checked on us often, made … || Although it is a huge hotel with thousands of guests, it is surprisingly calm and clean. The Amenities seem to be good. I only used the gym which is a small room in the basement and very basic and a little run down, but it did its job. … || We have celebrated a family event in the Eilat queen of Sheba hotel and it exceeded our expectations by far! The facilities are super and on top of that the level of service was amazing, we truly appreciate the staff and hotel management … || We had stayed in a refurnished suit (room 929). Didn't use the pool nor the spa facilities.  Pros: The view is second to none. Breakfast and B.lounge were very good. Room is large.  Cons: The entire hotel hall smells. old carpets. you can feel/see/smell its days are over. Although our room was refurnished, the mattress and pillows are not comfort nor their chip covers. no Shower but 80's old bath. risky to get in-out. you can hardly stand in, and if you are 180cm+ you should bend to wash your head. luckily im not ;) || Dear Guests,   Thank you for your feedback.   We are sorry that we did not meet your expectations.   Sincerely,   Guest Relations Team || Overall, the hotel left a great impression — the food is varied, delicious, and offers a wide selection for every taste. The rooms are comfortable and well thought out, with quick service and linen changes on request. The staff are friendly and welcoming, creating a pleasant atmosphere. However, there’s one significant downside — the parking area is far too small for a hotel of this level. It’s almost always full, and guests often have to park far away and walk. Aside from that, it’s an excellent hotel that’s truly worth returning to. || Hi Tenks alot Best regards  M.relation ship || We had a blast with our friends. The resort has amazing food and drinks. And everyone we interacted with were very helpful. Specially ayelet the manage and abedhakim were wonderful || We are extremely dissatisfied with our experience at this hotel, primarily due to the appalling attitude and lack of basic professionalism displayed by the front desk staff. Upon arrival, we simply asked to view the rooms before making full payment to ensure they were suitable for our group of nine. Instead of a reasonable response, we were met with hostility from a woman named “Eti,” who immediately raised her voice, aggressively insisting that “it’s impossible” to see the rooms and telling us to “take our money and leave” if we didn’t like it.  This behavior was entirely unacceptable, and we were forced to escalate the situation to the manager — who, disappointingly, adopted a similarly dismissive tone. She insisted the rooms matched the photos online, which was patently false. The images were misleading at best. Only after nearly an hour of back-and-forth did she reluctantly agree to upgrade our rooms, free of charge — a small gesture after a very poor first impression.  Parking was equally frustrating. The lot was full upon arrival, and we were made to wait outside the closed gate for nearly an hour until other guests left.  As for the rooms themselves: “moderately clean” would be a generous description. Ripped blankets, stained carpets, and worn-down furnishings do not reflect the standards this hotel claims to uphold.  Overall, this stay fell far below expectations for a hotel of this reputation. Between the combative staff, misrepresented accommodations, and poor logistical management, we cannot recommend this property and will not be returning. || Disgraceful service for a hotel of this level. There were no bathrobes or slippers in the room. No one cleans the pool area; dirty mugs sat there for half a day, and no one came to pick them up. The restrooms in the public areas are filthy. You don't expect such service from a hotel of this level. || Hi Tanks alot Best regards  M relationship || We stay at hotel at November for 5 days,room on 7 floor for couple.Elevators doesn't work properly and we stay waiting a lot.When we asked form room service to get EMPTY plates for the fruits to the room ,we were charged 15 shekels on service ,that even not 3 stars service. || Dear guests,   I am sorry that we did not meet your expectations.   I would be happy to talk.   Sincerely, Guest Relations Team

Great food service. Had the tuna sandwich and cappuccino was great very good and filling || Cute place, nice breakfast and lovely, peaceful vibe off the beaten path. || We were looking for a place for breakfast for a couple, we ordered an additional double breakfast, besides the standard and simple one, the dips are suitable for one person and not for a couple, for each additional dip they demand money, the meal includes a soft drink and a hot drink. We wanted to replace the soft drink with this carrot juice with an additional payment of 10 NIS for a tiny glass. When we told the waiter everything, he repeated that the owner of the house would come to us, until we finished he did not come. In short, a casual, expensive meal, stingy and the worst service from the owner of the place. I will not return here. || A renewed, renovated and very, very pleasant place to sit, both inside and outside. We arrived as a family of 4. They seated us immediately at a table and came over to recommend and help with the choice. The food arrived as soon as all the orders were prepared, everything was hot, fresh and delicious. The waiter named Daniel was really helpful and pleasant. Thank you for the hospitality and the pleasant experience! ⚘️♥️ || A cozy and delicious place. When we arrived it was busy and there were no seats in the shade, we asked to sit inside and within minutes we got a table (5 people!). We were warned that the kitchen was busy and the food would be delayed for half an hour, we got everything after 10 minutes. Everything was fresh and delicious, the food and the coffee too. Recommended. || We arrived about a week and a half ago, out of curiosity to try the “new” place. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing.  Right at the beginning of our visit, we were seated at a table that hadn’t been replaced after use, with a prominent burn mark in the center – an unpleasant sight that immediately spoiled the sense of cleanliness and atmosphere.  I ordered shakshuka, which was extremely disappointing: it arrived barely cooked, with eggs that weren’t fully cooked, and half of the pan at the bottom was burnt – which gave the entire dish a charred aftertaste. In addition, the tomato sauce tasted like canned tomatoes and wasn’t fresh.  My partner ordered breakfast, which was served in a meager manner – an omelet on a large, almost completely empty plate, with very few dips for the two of us. The bread was fresh, which was probably the only advantage. Overall, the price (140 NIS for a breakfast for two) is not worth the money.  The service was slow and inconsistent: it took a long time to get a menu, even though I had asked for it at the beginning of my arrival, and there were very few diners in the restaurant. Two employees were at the counter, but it took several requests on my part, and a wait of over 10 minutes to get the menu.  The unpleasant feeling was completed with the toilets – very dirty, without paper to wipe hands, even after we asked several times to fill the facility. The level of cleanliness was so poor that my partner chose to hold off until we got home.  Summary: A very disappointing experience in terms of food quality, service and cleanliness. Unfortunately, does not warrant a return visit. || Lovely service from the manager Noam, and his team Daniel and his friend The place has delicious food and a stunning dessert, breakfast, with a fair price, a restaurant that in the evening becomes a completely different dairy restaurant, with a different menu,  Raanan Shaar Hadera, good luck || Very pleasant atmosphere, music in the background, plenty of seating inside and outside, and excellent service. The menu is extensive and the breakfast is excellent. || Excellent coffee from Mauro Breakfast was also excellent.. There is only a double room || Cozy place, great service and lovely staff. But- small and disappointing portions in my opinion.. There is almost always a parking problem. Menu "on the run", so I try to be forgiving, but for now it is very poor- more or less you choose between Benedict with one slice of burnt brioche, shakshuka, a small breakfast or salad. Coffee and orange juice (the other squeezed juices do not exist).

Exceptional food served with a smile- I had burger and fries which was 1/2 pound but I would recommend medium well since medium was a little rare. My wife had a feta salad which was huge and fantastic. We both started with stuffed grape  leaves on bed of tzatziki which was the best I’ve ever had || The portion size is filling, the salmon was well done and the mashed potatoes (dairy) was soft and tasty. The atmosphere is inviting and fun (especially if you sit outside). Great for any craving! || There sure is a reservation-communication problem, however we got sorted out quickly. The atmosphere is relax and feels like home. The food is just great. Tasty and well served. We ordered salads, pasta and a chicken dish. Excellent food!! || The pastas are excellent.  When we came without reservations we were allotted an hour and fifteen minutes even though there were plenty of free tables.  Cordial service.  Happy hour 17-18 Sunday to Thursday. || Best breakfast that money can buy. Clean place which is important when buying food. The owner is sweet and takes care of uncomfortable situations with love. Makes you keep coming back for more. Food is really good and not super expensive. Enjoyed every minute || It was my first time in Branja restaurant and I really enjoyed my visit. I had green shakshuka for lunch, which was really good. The staff is very friendly, they made me feel welcomed. They have an english menu, prices are reasonable. Toilets are very clean. Interior and art on the walls are cool. It's a hip place and I'd go there again. || Love this place! It was our favorite in Eilat and we ate here several times during our short stay. reviews_content: My recent visit to Dakota restaurant was quite underwhelming. The service was notably slow, with a 30-minute delay before our food arrived and no explanation or acknowledgment of the wait. When my meal finally did arrive, the steak was unfortunately not cooked to the specification I had requested, which was disappointing given the restaurant’s reputation.  Adding to the poor experience, my family had already finished their meals by the time mine arrived, and they had moved on to dessert while I was still trying to finish my main course — which made the entire dining experience feel disjointed and uncomfortable.  To make matters worse, we were served the wrong bottle of wine and only discovered the mistake after questioning it — something that should have been communicated upfront. The manager did offer a complimentary glass of wine and desserts as an apology, but I had already ordered a glass, and as I’m mindful of my diet, I tend to avoid desserts, so the gesture did little to resolve the disappointment.  For the price point, the overall experience fell far short of expectations. The fish was cooked with the skin seared to a crisp, salted just right, and placed over a bed of perfectly cooked risotto in a perfectly balanced lemon butter. It was so tasty that I couldn't leave one drop of lemon butter on the dish. I also tried my wife's chestnut ravioli with fish, and the fish was identical to the first, and I was surprised by the quality of the ravioli, which was clearly hand-made at the restaurant, and with fresh roasted chestnuts. For all family.

had a really great stay at Hakaia Community Hostel . The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, the place is clean and comfortable, and the staff are incredibly kind and helpful. It truly felt like a second home.  the community vibe makes it easy to meet great people from all over the world.  I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Aqaba and I’d definitely stay here again. Thank you Hakaia team for such a wonderful experience! || Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re delighted you felt at home and enjoyed the community vibe. We can’t wait to welcome you back to Hakaia! || I traveled to 41+ countries and Hekaia is one of only two hostels that truly impressed me the most (the other being Downtown hostel in Srilanka), Hekaia (which is the Arabic word for “story” or “tale”) has soul and atmosphere, it is the first official hostel in Aqaba and possibly Jordan, the owners Bahaa and Mohammed and their friends like Farah and volunteers like Wayin are truly dedicated to making this place a memorable highlight in every traveler’s journey. I can’t recommend this place enough!  The hostel itself is in an excellent location very safe street with a police station nearby and close to all major attractions, and it’s not too big (which would have made it impersonal) or too small, it’s perfect for socializing, super clean and well maintained, above all it has true authentic soul. It was one of the highlights of my trip to Jordan. Thank you Hekaia Family! || Thank you so much, Hasan, for this amazing review! We’re truly honored to hear that Hakaia made such a memorable impression on your travels. It means the world to us that you felt the soul and atmosphere of our hostel, and we’re so happy you enjoyed our community, comfort, and location. Your kind words inspire us to keep creating memorable experiences for every traveler. We hope to welcome you back to Hakaia again soon, the doors are always open for you! || This hotel is absolutely wonderful. The staff provide fantastic service and are always helpful and friendly. Everything is very clean, the beds are comfortable, and the breakfasts are delicious. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making the stay truly enjoyable. The location is also excellent, convenient for exploring the area. Every true traveler should visit this place at least once. Highly recommended! || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We truly appreciate your kind words and recommendation. It means a lot to us that you enjoyed your stay, and we hope to welcome you again in the future. || Super nice and cosy hostel in the heart of Aqaba, Jordan. Amenities are super good, showers and beds are very comfortable and cosy.  Living spaces and lounge are super spacious and well looked after. This hostel feels more like a home rather than a hostel.  Breakfast is a nice touch and is super super tasty! || Thank you so much for your kind words and positive feedback! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience. It means a lot to us, and we hope to welcome you back again in the future. || More than a hostel Hakaia is a travelers refuge. The moment you step over the threshold you'll feel at ease. So much so that I, like many of guests, ended up extending my stay multiple times.  It's a place where  conversations flow and stories are shared amongst friends - Hakaia being the Arabic for story. The atmosphere is lively and social, whilst also being immensely peaceful and calm for those wanting solitude and rest. In short it's a sanctuary you won't want to leave.  This is a direct consequence of the wonderful staff all of whom are kind, passionate and genuinely committed to ensuring that guests have a great time. They do everything to help you whether it's giving advice of things to see, helping you with visa documentation or just sharing stories, games and pleasant conversation.  Additionally the included breakfast is tasty treat that will certainly set you up for the day. || Hakaia Hostel has been one of the highlights during my trip in Jordan. I just stayed 2 days but I felt like home, and it is something really hard to find. They have put a lot of effort and love to build this place and community and the result is a place from which you would never leave. Visit Aqaba is worth it just for staying in this warm home. I hope to come back one day. Many thanks for the passion and love that you have invested here. || I had an amazing time at Hakaia Hostel!! Baha'a and Abraham are amazing host and they take care of you so well. Atmosphere in the hostel was super nice too!!  I'm so glad that I stayed here and if I come back to Aqaba, I'll definitely stay Hakaia again!! || Thank you so much for your kind review! We’re really glad you had a great experience with us. It was a pleasure hosting you, and we hope to welcome you again in the future. || Easy 5 stars for me! I’ve been to many hostels around the world, and only a few truly stand out, Hakaia is one of them. It’s a hostel run with real passion by its owners. The hospitality and friendliness were unmatched; you can feel how cozy and welcoming the atmosphere is the moment you walk in. Bahaa, Mohammed, and Farah are the stars behind it all. I highly recommend this hostel and I’d definitely come back again whenever I find myself in Aqaba 🫶🏻 || Let’s be honest about Hakaia.  The beach is about 500m away, the airport is 15 minutes by taxi (around 7 JD), and the best restaurants are within 1 km. Make sure to get the recommendations for food spots from the funny staff Mohammad, I left Aqaba totally satisfied with the food thanks to his list! 😍 He is also the one who can give the best tips on what to do around town. And if you’re not sure what stuff should cost in Aqaba, he’ll guide you. Hakaia is also connected with scuba diving, Wadi Rum, and Petra tours, so you’re covered even if you didn’t plan ahead. No worries getting scammed. Hakaia’s nightly rate is super affordable compared to other places in the area. They’ve got pretty much everything you might need: clean & cozy room, chill kitchen, balcony for laundry, a workspace, free water shoes, snorkeling gear, tasty breakfast. Only thing I struggled with was the stairs at the entrance but the staff always help out 🫶🏻 Safe and at ease. That’s exactly how I felt staying at Hakaia 👏🏻 || Hakaia was my favourite stay in Jordan! Run by truly the most lovely humans 🩷 they are so welcoming and can help you with anything you need. It felt like home arriving here!! I would recommend to anyone I know || Thank you for your kind words! We’re so glad you felt at home and enjoyed your stay. We’d love to welcome you back to Hakaia anytime!

We visited the Three Monkeys Bar in Eilat as a group of eight on a weekday. There weren’t many free seats, but we did manage to get a table. There was a nice live performance, and people were dancing on the floor, creating a fun and lively atmosphere. The place is very loud, so it’s less suitable if you’re just looking to have a conversation. Overall, a good experience — we’ll definitely come back. || We were the first customers to arrive at 8 pm, so the place was empty, but it already had a nice atmosphere. We were told that there would be a live music band on at 10 p.m., and the show started right on time. The band was great, and many people started dancing on the dance floor next to the stage. There was a nice selection of beers, but only one option for wine, which was a little disappointing. || A very friendly and professional service.  The barman was very good at preparing the cocktails. But if you like the 80s, it's worth a visit. There's a band that plays music that makes you happy. Better to come on Friday. || Cool live music but not so amazing Coketails. Cheers! || Very nice pub with a good vibes, live music🎸 and songs🕺, fine 🍺 and tasty cocktails🍹. No parking 🤷🏻‍♂️ || One of the famous places of Eilat. Great location. offer a good selection of beers. The main attribute is live music, played mainly by British musicians. Left after 35 minutes without getting anything to drink, They totally ruined our night out. Will never go back there and nither should you.

Much quieter, cozier, simpler bar with a huge history. The choice of drinks is fantastic - whole wall cabinet. As well, the soundtrack gravitates towards rock. Awesome place but you have to tolerate cigarette smell for a while. After all, sometimes we can indulge? || Gabbys pub eilat Best and i think one of the oldest pubs in israel since 1989 ,great classic rock music great vibes and very entertaining owner,drinks more than the clients 😀 || A real institute, open since 1989, run by the one and only Gaby. Come only if you know what you are looking for. This is not for amateurs. || Good people go here, it's a real pub and the last of it's kind in Eilat and a dying breed in the world. The bar is owned by the bar tender and he has so much energy it's incredible. The music is ALWAYS INCREDIBLE  good old rock really really good songs. I always go here, no judgement just good people good beer and good vibes. Love the bar one of my favorites in the world. || Perfect spot to get away from the noise and crowds of Eilat. Classic small pub, had an excellent combination of great whiskey and tasty food delivered directly to my table from a nearby restaurant, thanks to a successful collaboration. || a lovely, tiny old-school pub. Gabi, serves great 60-70's music, booze and carrots. This place haven't changed a bit in the last 30 years, and it's got more character than any other pub in Eilat. || Easily the best Matcha I had in town. Thank you Gus for the amazing service and recommendations. || Best Bar in Eilat, Amazing owners and regular customers to create the perfect atmosphere for beer and blues! Quoting Greatful Dead: ONCE IN A WHILE YOU GET SHOWN THE LIGHT, IN THE STRANGEST OF PLACES IF YOU LOOK AT IT RIGHT. || this is the coolest bar in eilat. and I checked many || Oldest pub in Eilat! Great place to talk about Eilat with locals on a drink. Don’t miss the carrot, it’s a must!

reviews_content: One of my best food and service experiences is Israel. The restaurant is new but the staff and food don't feel like it. The food was of course the highlight, but the service was amazing, the cheff himself came to the tables to ask for the diner's opinions. Music and lighting were just right, didn't have to wait long for the foor or drinks. The place itself is outdoors but doesn't feel hot or uncomfortable. If I ever find myself in Eilat again, definitely will pay a visit. || We're glad you chose to join our mood ♥ || A fresh gastronomique restaurant in Eilat! Liked complicated tastes of the dishes, some of them spicy. Tasted seven courses - and all of them were perfect! Light white wines would match all of them (we selected Pinot Gris and Sancerre). || The vibe is amazing, especially for a date or something for intimate. There was not too much variety and I ended up getting a pizza, but even that wasn’t bad. THE PASTA though was incredible. The sauce was perfect, the texture and the softness as well. Recommend! || It was amazing food, atmosphere and service! Truly recommend. || It is a modern kosher restaurant with a nice atmosphere. The kitchen is an interesting mix of Italian and sushi. The staff was trying to do their best, and they did a good job. The food was good without being anything too special. There is a small pool that creates nicer surroundings. || So disappointed, I thought I would eat in a cozy, lounge place with good music and subdued lighting, I found myself in a canteen in the middle of strollers. || Hello Sandrine,  Thank you for sharing your feelings with us. We certainly understand your disappointment – ​​Eilat during this season is full of families, and in the earlier hours we welcome everyone with love, even with strollers. After 10:00 PM the atmosphere changes completely – exactly to the lounge atmosphere with the music and lighting you were looking for.  It is also important for us to note – personal disappointment with the atmosphere does not necessarily justify a rating of only two stars, unless the food, service or design were also not to your satisfaction.  We would be happy to host you again at a later time, so that you can enjoy the real Mood, and perhaps also improve your mood 😉.  Best regards, Mood Restaurant Team  English  Hi Sandrine,  Thank you for sharing your feedback. The menu lacked variety and didn’t offer anything unique; Having eaten at many sushi restaurants, I found this one to be below average, with the rolls being thinner than usual. We will address this issue with the team to prevent such cases in the future. We’d love to host you again for an even better experience. || What a great vibe and food, and the staff so incredible, Tomer and Yarom were so on it… sweethearts ♥️🙏

My favourite bar in Eilat. If you want to feel home and experience the true local company- that is the place || We are a couple from Australia, we arrived in Eilat for the first time, we were looking for a nice pub to drink and experience an Israeli atmosphere. We arrived there without any intention, and good that it happened, the pub is magical, the atmosphere is amazing and warm, the owners are lovely, We have never encountered such a family pub that does not stop indulging. It is highly recommended that there is no doubt that in our next visit we are there!! || Quiet cozy place, excellent for having a few drinks with a date.  Not expensive. || A quiet and clean place with a good atmosphere, the owner Gekko, who generously pampers at prices that are affordable for everyone. || Simply magical! The bar has character, atmosphere and a simply amazing welcome from the owners, Jacko and Shoshi, who are a lovely and special couple. The place is a hidden gem that hosts mainly long-time Eilat residents, but not only. A fun place to sit and indulge in quality alcohol and snacks from the heart, have a conversation with the "regulars" and leave feeling the best there is! We really really enjoyed ourselves and we will definitely be back again and again! || An amazing place in a local and quiet and calm atmosphere. The perfect place to go out and start the week. Special design, authentic dishes and nibbled generously. We will come back again, my favorite in Eilat! || An old pub.. "Like the old days" is located in the Shalom Center in Eilat.. which is also from "the old days"... regular customers.. the owner is called Jaco.. like the parrot.. a mythical man with his amazing wife who is a cook.. Mazets flow non-stop on the tables.. in addition to the house flavors that are truly delicious.. drinks without nonsense.. the most original.. no cocktails from the north.. hello.. this is Eilat. There are no northerners in Eilat..only gnarled southern Eilatians..tanned..and young people of all ages..there is.."Bring me a whiskey..coke on the side" which is the best cocktail there is..what is called..mix me a vodka and Red Bull..two types of draft beer without getting involved..and a great atmosphere of the time tunnel..great place..everyone is welcome, even northerners who want a trip through the time tunnel..great people..prices are ridiculous..come on..tell Daniel he sent you..whoever comes..deserves it..and whoever doesn't come..deserves it too..the tradition must be maintained..love you guys..❤❤❤ || An Eilat bar experience with all the heart and soul. Drinks at reasonable prices, food served as an appetizer on the house, delicious, high-quality, inviting and enjoyable. A great corner to sip a glass of wine, beer or coffee.

We came in the morning to have a morning coffee and came out with a smile on our faces, the service is amazing, the barista explained to us what options we have, gave us suggestions, gave a back story on the coffee beans and  different flavors. I can say this was the best cup of coffee I've had in a long time. || Tasteful breakfast, excellent coffee, super service 👍🏻 || Woow! The best coffee in Eilat! || Tasty coffee , great service ! || Best service ..  my friends.. tasty coffee and tea and everything yiu must try !! || The only place in the city with European level drinks and service! Highly recommend! || Thank you very much...

The restaurant was empty, except for another couple. They waited on us for 29 minutes. The bartender knows his stuff , if you ask from something not in the menu and he knows it? He will make it and it will be great. The prices are reasonable and the service is quick || Paddy's is the local Irish pub in Eilat ( Yes, Apparently every city has an Irish Pub 🤣). They also have a large selection of beers to choose from, along with a full bar and surprisingly decadent desserts 🎂. Great for families or just hanging out with friends to watch a came. || For a pub, this place serves very decent food from a wide menu. Even the pub favorites (burgers, fish&chips, etc.) are surprisingly good. Many kinds of beers available. Good place to have a dinner with kids. Why 4 points then? The one beer I was interested in was not available, and the waitress was very confused, both with prices and the orders. This may happen, though. || Very positive experience. The waiter was patient and explained to us the different food options. We ordered one of the menus that included a drink and a 50% discount on desserts.  The fish and chips dish  was delicious and tasty. The lemonade had too much sugar for my taste but could mix it with water.  We shared one of their desserts (the apple pie) which was served with a vanilla ice cream and whipped cream. Simply delicious.  You are served some peanuts and vegetables to eat while you wait for your dish/drink. || Good place to visit. Always tasty food and a lot of fresh beers. Not cheap but worth it. || The combination of rich bar and restaurant. Bar is rich from beers to cocktails and heavy drinks. The food is very good, I ordered the steak and it was soft and well served. The music was awesome and not too loud or low. The sitting area outside is pretty and has really nice breeze during evening. The service was great and welcoming. Definitely going to return for a second.

We where greeted with the words: "I'm Sory but you came in the worst night ever. Our taps don't work, the band canceld on the last mint".we decided to stay. It was a great gin and tonic. I will definitely come back next time. || customer service was okay, but there were no menus, music was way too loud, the lighting was terrible (way too dark) and drinks were very overpriced || Sorry for you and this experience. Yes there’s no menus Only special ones for wine bottles etc.. Regular orders as water beer and cocktails are known prices so for Israel Eilat were cheap. our bartenders and waitres are well known with all prices, shame you didn’t ask the price before ordering. And we’re not a club, we’re a bar a real local bar that weekends are crazy mad and middle of the week it’s dark with a band or stage lights sorry that you couldn’t see clear at the dark. || No COVID-19 certificate (green pass) checks, at least for none of my friends and I. || Just wow!! Very cool vibes || Exellent homecafe with nightstyle 😉 …

Love this place!! Food is delicious and the portions are great. The staff is awesome and very friendly,  especially Mike. Atmosphere and vibes are so chill and welcoming to everyone,  even great for a family night out. Music always on point and the drinks are mixed well. Definitely worth a visit! You wont be disappointed!!! || Thanks Denise, hope to see you again soon || The food is pretty bad. The wings are prepared in advance and have strong chicken after taste. The burger is dry.  I guess if you there for a drink and a show it can be nice. But avoid it as a dinner. || Awesome food, awesome location with great waterfront views, great sports bar! Prices were reasonable during tourist season in Eilat. Highly recommend the double Mike's Burger if you are hungry (see pictures), guarantee you will not be hungry after eating it! I've been a long mikes place goers in Tel Aviv ..wenn I was young ...so it all looks the same .. There are also  live performances (a bit to loud for my age ) ... Enjoy 🤠 || Thanks, hope to see you soon || the place was absolutely amazing. the interior, service, music, and food and drinks were top notch. Definitely recommend 👌 || Thanks for the awesome review Rona || We were there every evening from 23.09 to 26.09. And every time great food, different dishes, always free space for sitting under air condition. Children were happy too. Beer is great. || Thanks so much for the great review!! We appreciate you!! Hope to see you back soon || Great atmosphere, cold beer, good food, unexpectedly good live band, what else do you need? Sitting area outside has a beautiful view to the yachts in marina, nice during the day, romantic in the evening... Bar inside bit crowded but that's ok in Israel, we are all one big family... I think that reservation is not necessary unless you are a big party... || Went on Monday, good music, good vibe Didn't eat only drink so can't rate the food || Thanks Moti, we appreciate you || Sagiv was our server and he was so helpful. We felt like we were his only customer. We love coming to Mike’s place every time in Israel- especially for Happy Hour!! || Worst service.  I was a frequent customer of this place.  Every time we came to Eilat, we came to this place and sat down at the same table in the corner.  It was already a tradition.  Came here yesterday as well.  But an incident happened - the waiters forced us to vacate this place and look for a smaller table, since more people could be seated at this table.  I just got up and walked out of there.  The greed of the establishment led to the loss of a regular customer || Sorry Oleg, it’s not greedy to try and maximize the space you have. It is normal practice in any professional restaurant.

After finding this restaurant on google we decided to give it a try as it was newly kosher. We were so happy with our choice. It feels like homely family run place. Everything we ordered was fresh generous and tasty. My husband had the fish soup which he said was insanely delicious. Salads huge and crunchy and very fresh. And the fish of course was full of flavour and grilled to perfection. The place isn’t fancy but very authentic and clean and the prices reflect that as they’re reasonable. I would 100% recommend. || Thank you very much ❤️ || This place is such a great find. Super fresh fish, simply done and full of flavor. Everything feels home-style and comforting, but still really well thought out and well executed. As a kosher fish spot in Eilat, this place truly stands out for its  freshness and quality.  We loved every bite and would happily come back again. || Thank you very much 🙏 … || INCREDIBLE fish restaurant. One of our favorite meals of our time in Israel. Delicious and fresh fish. Don’t miss out on the fish cigars, SHAWARMA, and fried sea bass. Service was warm, friendly, and patient with our broken Hebrew. Cannot recommend enough! || Thank you very much 🙏 … || I really wanted to eat good fish and booked a table. The restaurant inside, reminds me of the old european restaurants. The hostess was wonderful and gave us great tips on what we should try. Everything was divine (never had such a good ceviche and I've travelled a lot). We loved everything and will come back for sure! || If you like to eat good and tasty fish, this restaurant is the right place. Each time when me and my wife went to Eilat we visited Rak Dagim and were satisfied with the delicious dinner. || Thank you very much 🙏 … || Old school classic fish 👌  The locals little secret, my wife (Israeli) took me the first night of our trip, she couldn’t wait to share this place with me.  I happily recommend if you want the best fresh fish in Eilat within a relaxed and traditional atmosphere. || The food itself was very good! Having said that, we expected more from the service. There were relatively low amount of people (3-4 tables) but we’ve waited a long time just to order or get the attention of the staff. It felt like a very laid back place where you come and is expected to spend a very long time in. || Rak Dagim in Eilat was one of the best dining experiences we’ve had in a long time. From the moment we sat down, the hospitality was incredible. We told them right away, “Just bring us something delicious,” and they did exactly that. Without even asking for a menu, they started us off with fresh salad, creamy baba ghanoush, and warm garlic bread that was insanely good. Everything tasted fresh and homemade, and the vibe in the restaurant was laid-back but full of good energy.  What came next was a surprise multicourse meal that completely exceeded our expectations. The owner, who was kind and welcoming, brought out a huge whole fish cooked with lemon and herbs, served with soft roasted potatoes that soaked up all the flavor. It was clean, rich, and cooked perfectly. We had wine with the meal and just relaxed into it — no rush, just good food and conversation in a place that felt like home.  The restaurant itself has a cozy, inviting atmosphere with simple but tasteful design. It’s a Greek-style place, and you can tell they put real heart into what they serve. The whole experience felt authentic and thoughtful — no frills, just excellent food and genuine hospitality. If you’re in Eilat, Rak Dagim is a spot you don’t want to miss. || Excellent Service just steps from the Eilat promenade. Food was outstanding and hostesses were attentive and helpful. We ordered a fresh salad, grilled aubergine, fish arayas, and a whole fish, paired with a bottle of crisp white wine. Every dish was exceptionally fresh, bursting with flavor, and beautifully presented. We were so immersed in the food that we completely forgot to take photos!  This place is a must-visit for seafood lovers. The quality, service, and experience were all top-notch. Highly, highly, highly recommend!

Overall, it remains one of the most activity-rich hotels in Eilat, but the standards decline each year and might no longer fully justify the price.  Room cleanliness was disappointing. We were upgraded from a Superior U room (the most basic category) to a balcony room, but the upgrade was not worthwhile. Last time we stayed in the Superior U room, and to me it felt newer, cleaner, and had a much nicer bathroom than the balcony room. The Superior U bathroom, while shower-only, is more spacious and modern. Reception handled this well and graciously offered us an additional night at a slightly discounted rate (around 10%), which we declined. Unlimited cocktails are fun, but the bar offering is basic. Mostly straight liquors with fruit juices. The slushies are extremely sweet and artificial.
